decisions.reason: The formwork profile system had its own page in both observed years, which signals a core modular component in the firm's precast formwork range; it costs little to keep and still has upside from automation and customer demand.

The shuttering magnet block is a low-cost consumable that fits the firm's magnetic formwork portfolio, and with no evidence of failure, keeping this cheap option open is sensible even though it was only mentioned rather than featured.
This magnetic formwork component kept its own page through 2019, which suggests positive market feedback, and it complements the firm's integrated systems at low holding cost.
This component is less prominent and overlaps with E and C, so consolidation is possible, but the low cost of keeping it in an expanding market argues for retaining the option.
